g.text: All 30 worlds: same final extinction, different persistence
Equal initial food energy, different extinction times
Each world starts with 5,120 food + 1,920 organism energy. Fixed trait 250, no mutation, unchanged V0 dynamics.
Maps show the first declared seed, not an average. Lines connect matched seeds, not identical later random draws. No universal geometry effect claimed.
